coverage_assessment: Provider Roles & Product Families: Evaluated across all 200 cases. Product families (networking: 50, security: 47, load-balancing: 33, infrastructure: 18, dns: 14, administration: 10, api-management: 7, cloud: 6, container: 6, monitoring: 6, identity: 3) are comprehensively represented. Provider roles (resource: 155, data-source: 22, action: 11, none/control: 8, ephemeral-resource: 3, provider: 1) are properly assigned, distinguishing resources from read-only data sources.

Schema Depth & Leaf Uniqueness: 55 answerable cases achieve verified schema depth >= 8, surpassing the minimum threshold of 50. All 10 previously failing cases (case-ans-012 to case-ans-021) have been repaired to target valid canonical hierarchy paths in gcp_vpc_site static routes and fleet storage device orchestrator, with exact depth-to-schema_path length alignment (depth == len(schema_path)). All 140 answerable destinations are unique and verified against alternate schema branches.

Required Topic Coverage: Full coverage confirmed for provider authentication (case-ans-056), imports (case-ans-067 to case-ans-072), timeouts (case-ans-073 to case-ans-075, case-ans-106, case-ans-112, case-ans-138, case-ans-140), actions (case-ans-059 to case-ans-066), ephemeral resources (case-ans-057, case-ans-058, case-amb-020), nested TLS (case-ans-076 to case-ans-078, case-ans-132), Bot Defense successful-login results (case-ans-004 to case-ans-006), existing certificates (case-ans-070, case-ans-077, case-ans-090), backend servers (case-ans-022 to case-ans-025, case-ans-079 to case-ans-086), credential setup (case-ans-009, case-ans-056, case-ans-057, case-ctl-003), unsupported fields (case-ctl-009 to case-ctl-016), and ordinary documentation discovery (case-ctl-001 to case-ctl-008).

Ambiguity Handling: All 40 ambiguous cases audited. Each case exhibits genuine destination ambiguity between competing canonical branches or resource vs data-source roles, specifying clear clarification instructions and at least two valid permitted destination choices with valid anchors. No ambiguous case conflates missing HCL values or omitted provider names with destination ambiguity.

Controls & Negative Cases: All 20 control cases audited. 8 ordinary-discovery cases correctly omit URIs and represent platform UI/API lookups; 8 unsupported cases were independently verified across all 18,958 files in documentation/ as absent from the corpus; 4 no-live-claim cases correctly target live telemetry and operational state.

Model Subset (40 IDs): The 40-case evaluation subset conforms exactly to the required ratio (28 answerable, 8 ambiguous, 4 control). All 40 subset cases, including repaired cases case-ans-016 and case-ans-021, pass structural validation and verify against canonical documentation, making the subset qualified for HCL drafting and provenance benchmarking.
limitations: Verification conducted strictly against canonical documentation/ and source.json without executing Terraform CLI commands or network calls, in accordance with benchmark isolation policies.
Live operational telemetry and real-time runtime state queries are restricted to no-live-claim controls, reflecting Terraform static configuration boundaries.
Corpus-wide absence checks for unsupported field controls are bound specifically to the canonical documentation tree at the pinned provider commit.
